content.thinking: `decompress` one-shot needs content size. Use stream_reader.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,io
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_content_size=False)
d=bytearray(c.compress(b'hello world'))
d2=bytearray(d[:6])+b'\x00'+bytearray(d[6:]);d2[4]=(d2[4]&~0x03)|0x01
try:
 r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(d2)),read_across_frames=True);print('decomp',r.read())
except Exception as e: print('ERR',type(e),e)
EOF
